wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 03-004 wires IWAD, default.cfg, chocolate-doom.cfg, and savedir discovery into a single typed LaunchContext consumed by the future engine init order. Both read-only refs (src/bootstrap/implement-iwad-discovery-order.ts and the entire src/config/ tree) are SHA-pinned by plan_vanilla_parity inventory tests (inventory-src-bootstrap-surface.test.ts pins every bootstrap module's sha256; inventory-save-and-config-modules.test.ts pins src/bootstrap/config.ts and the src/save/ surface). Modifying either would break those inventory tests. Wiring is therefore implemented as a new src/vanilla/launchContext.ts that imports VANILLA_IWAD_CANDIDATES, VANILLA_DEFAULT_SEARCH_DIRECTORY, and identifyMission from the existing read-only modules without modifying them. The wrapper consumes a CommandLineConfiguration and a caller-supplied LaunchContextEnvironment (DOOMWADDIR value + basename-existence predicate) so resolution is deterministic and free of direct filesystem I/O. A subsequent host bring-up step will adapt a Bun-backed environment.
publicSurface: ResolvedIwad interface (source, resolvedPath, searchDirectory, matchedFilename, probedSequence, gameMode, gameMission)

iwadDiscoveryBranches.iwadFlagMode: explicit -iwad <path> honored verbatim; canonical basename match recognized case-insensitively; non-canonical basename yields gameMode=indetermined while identifyMission still recognizes mission via existing src/bootstrap/gameMode.ts table; Windows backslash separators accepted in path basename extraction
iwadDiscoveryBranches.discoveryMode: walks VANILLA_IWAD_CANDIDATES in canonical order; first-match-wins; DOOMWADDIR=null collapses to '.'; DOOMWADDIR=<path> prefixes every candidate; full seven-entry probe sequence walked when no match; iwad-flag short-circuits the probe (zero invocations of the existence predicate)

configResolutionBranches.defaultConfigPath: honors -config <path> override per Chocolate Doom 2.2.1 M_SetConfigFilenames main-config slot; falls back to literal 'default.cfg' when absent
configResolutionBranches.hostConfigPath: always 'chocolate-doom.cfg' — -extraconfig is not wired by 03-003 so no override branch exists yet
configResolutionBranches.saveDirectory: honors -savedir <path> override; falls back to literal '.' when absent

crossPlanInventoryUpdate.rationale: src/vanilla/ is not declared as a source_roots entry in any plan_vanilla_parity classify-real / classify-simplified / classify-stubbed group, and test/plan_final/launch/ is not declared as a test_roots entry in any plan_vanilla_parity inventory. The full 15614-test suite passes without any plan_vanilla_parity inventory rewrite, matching the 03-001 and 03-003 precedent for src/vanilla/ additions.
